data.name: Charvik
data.gender_notes: Charvik is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Charvik is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Char' meaning 'foremost' and 'Vik' meaning 'power'. This name is believed to represent the immense power of Lord Shiva. In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva is the supreme god who embodies both creation and destruction. The name Charvik carries the meaning “Lord Shiva's power” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Charvik usually hope their child will grow to embody lord shiva's power and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Charvik total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: Charvik is a unique and powerful name in Hindu culture, reflecting the reverence and awe for Lord Shiva, the foremost deity in Hinduism. Naming a child Charvik conveys the deep spiritual belief in the supreme power of Lord Shiva.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Charvik holds great spiritual significance for Hindus. It symbolizes the power and strength of Lord Shiva, the ultimate divine power that transcends all human beings. It is believed that invoking the blessings of Lord Shiva by naming a child Charvik will bestow upon them immense power and protection in their journey through life. Additionally, the name reminds the bearer of the transient nature of human life and the importance of connecting with the divine to achieve spiritual enlightenment and liberation from the cycle of birth and death.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Charvik is a name derived from the Sanskrit word "Chatur-Vik" meaning 'Four Quarters' or 'All Directions'. It signifies the unity and wholeness of existence, representing the belief that the divine is present in every direction and aspect of life.

historical_references.reference: The Charviks were a warrior caste from the ancient Indian subcontinent, known for their martial prowess and loyalty to their kings. They are mentioned in various Hindu texts, including the Mahabharata and the Puranas.
historical_references.time_period: Circa 4th century BCE to 12th century CE

historical_references.reference: The Charviks are also believed to have been part of the court of the Satavahana dynasty, one of the major powers in ancient India during the 1st century BCE to 3rd century CE. They were likely responsible for the royal security and military might of the kingdom.
